steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Individualist cultures (e.g. USA, UK) prioritise personal goals, independence and individual rights. Collectivist cultures (e.g. Japan, China) prioritise group harmony, interdependence and social obligations. These values affect communication styles, conformity and self-concept. | Key Fact: High-context cultures (e.g. Japan, Arab nations) rely heavily on NVC, context and shared understanding - much is left unsaid. Low-context cultures (e.g. Germany, USA) rely on explicit, direct verbal communication - meaning is in the words. | Key Fact: Cultural differences in conformity: collectivist cultures show higher conformity rates (Smith & Bond's meta-analysis).
